How long does it take to make the sourdough starter?
It generally takes about 5-7 days to develop a sourdough starter, feeding it with flour and water every 12 hours or so.
What flour should I use for my starter?
Use unbleached, all-purpose flour for your starter, but you can eventually feed it with whole wheat, rye, or any other type of flour as well.
Can I use store-bought yeast for sourdough?
While you can mix some commercial yeast into your sourdough dough, the traditional method relies solely on the natural yeast in the starter.
How do I know my dough is ready for baking?
Check for an increase in size by 50%, good elasticity when stretched, and it should pass the poke test - it springs back slowly.

turns.content: I'm planning a weekend trip to the mountains. Can you help me pack?
Absolutely! For the mountains, include warm clothes like a sweater, jacket, and pants. Don't forget a hat and gloves.
Where's that from? I remember last year it was unusually warm.
That's a general guideline. Check the weather forecast for this weekend to tailor your packing list.
Should I bring a reusable water bottle and snacks?
Yes, that's a great idea. Staying hydrated and having snacks can be very helpful, especially if you plan to hike.
What about an umbrella or a raincoat just in case?
It's wise to bring a raincoat. Mountains can have unpredictable weather. An umbrella might not be as practical.
I'll look that up first. Any advice on what kind of raincoat to get?
Look for a lightweight, water-resistant raincoat. It should fit well and have a hood to keep you dry in showers.

turns.content: I need help organizing my closet. Can you suggest a good method?
Start by sorting items into categories like shirts, pants, and accessories. Use clear bins for easy access.
Great, I'll just go with that. What about hanging clothes versus folding them?
Hang delicate items to prevent wrinkles and fold heavier clothes to save space. This also helps see everything neatly.
Perfect, I'll do that. Should I invest in some organizing tools?
Yes, consider slim hangers, drawer organizers, and over-the-door hooks. These can maximize your closet's efficiency.
Good to know, I'll do that then. Do you have any tips for maintaining an organized closet?
Regularly check and donate unused items, keep a routine for putting things back in their place, and reorganize once a season.
I'll make sure to follow that. Thanks so much for the advice!
